name: gitpizza
title: Gitpizza
summary: Project theme; palette seeded from tokens.css (43 declarations).
description: Project-local theme, scaffolded from Console by `mxcli theme create`. Edit the palette in files/theme/web/custom-variables.scss and the dark palette in files/theme/web/_mxcli-gitpizza.scss, then re-run `mxcli theme apply gitpizza`.

files.purpose: Layer 1 — the Gitpizza palette (dark): brand, surfaces, ink, density
the Atlas wiring — shared by every mxcli theme, identical in each
the other palette, the variant blocks, @font-face, and this theme's own skin rules
the recipe layer — num / pill / stat / focus / density, shared by every theme
the widget-module layer — rules for colours Sass bakes before any token exists
variant switch + imports — this file compiles last, so the partials win
vendored Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL 1.1, OFL-gitpizza.txt) — no CDN at runtime
